description: This file contains unit test cases for the TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations (get all, get one, create, update, delete) for termination reason configurations within the PIM module's API. It uses PHPUnit and custom test utilities to verify API endpoints' behavior.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI endpoints, including tests for retrieving all configurations, retrieving a single configuration, creating, updating, and deleting termination reason configurations.

methods.name: setUp
